864-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2842-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

6797-7084-8232.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

767-4474-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-4474-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-2557-4094-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3413-5686-5929.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-3967-5434.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

240-2438-4452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2438-4452.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

856-3899-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3899-4321-7422.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

650-891-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2921-6249-7256--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2

3941-4331-4993-6595.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

539-2438-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4316-5078-5864-6055.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
4316-5078-5864-6055.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

222-527-5147-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2793-3921-5089-5666-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

1477-2058-2073.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

618-1268-6252.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
618-1268-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Kiki-Jiki's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1069-3156-4763-5004.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts, including an Equipment except Demonmail Hauberk.
1069-3156-4763-5004.description:
Activate an equipment except Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

913-2092-4222-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
913-2092-4222-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1349-5686-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-5686-6012.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1308-1887-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating two 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

2713-3062-5115.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

654-774-2137-3430.notablePrerequisites: High Tide in hand.You control at least two mana-producing lands.
654-774-2137-3430.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-1978-3363-4241.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-4241.description:
Animate The One Ring using Karn.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

1093-3363-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1093-3363-5131.description:
Activate Phyrexia's Core's second ability by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing The One Ring, causing you to gain one life.
Cast The One Ring from your graveyard by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2558-2829-3490-4390.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Sword of the Meek, adding {G}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.

1434-2047-3094-4659.notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Lithoform Engine.
1434-2047-3094-4659.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mechanized Production's ability, creating a token copy of Lithoform Engine.
Activate the Lithoform Engine token's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Lithoform Engine token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Liliana, Heretical Healer // Liliana, Defiant Necromancer

136-2945-4050-4556.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, adding {B}.
Cadaver Imp dies, triggering Blight Mound and Liliana, Heretical Healer.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Liliana, Heretical Healer trigger, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield transformed, and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Liliana, Defiant Necromancer's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it.
Liliana, Defiant Necromancer is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Liliana, Defiant Necromancer ability, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, returning Liliana, Heretical Healer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and the Pest tokens, adding {1}{B}.
The Pest dies, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Liliana, Heretical Healer by paying {1}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1110-2906-2931-4050.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.
1110-2906-2931-4050.description:
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Faceless One, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Repeat.

618-2584-4831.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Cacophodon with haste.
The Cacophodon token enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing damage to the Cacophodon token equal to its power.
The Cacophodon token triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
